blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The seven crewmen reported missing after their cargo boat capsized off Jomalig town in Quezon early Wednesday (Nov. 4), were rescued at 1 p.m. on the same day, police said in an updated report. READ: 7 men missing after cargo boat capsizes off Jomalig, Quezon The men were located 10 hours after their vessel, MV AC, was reported to have capsized and have since returned safely to their families in Barangay Talisoy, the Quezon Police Public Information Office (PIO) said in a belated report on Thursday afternoon (November 5) .
